title: Undo is offered after a turn whose apply created a row (page, post, first postmeta)
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/turn-undo.test.mjs
S2: Read the line for the test whose name starts with 'a create-recorded write pairs with its content.update audit row'.
expect: That test reports ok: a site_write recorded as content.create pairs with its content.update audit row, recovers the apply id and the turn's undo state is available (pre-fix: no pair, NOT_RECORDED/content).
evidence: Reproduced 4/4 on a WordPress dev site: create a page, write a post, set the first browser-tab title and meta description each answered 'Tracy has no record of some page edits it made'.
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/sites/turn-undo.js: pairWrites keys a via=apply content.create write as content.update, the audit row's action.

tests: a create-recorded write pairs with its content.update audit row
